questions.question: The main part of the ear responsible for hearing is:
Which part of the ear collects sound waves?
The tympanic membrane separates:
options: External ear from the middle ear
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. External ear from the middle ear

questions.question: The fluid that fills the membranous labyrinth is:
The sensory organ for equilibrium in the vestibule is:
The tympanic membrane separates the external ear from the middle ear.
The Eustachian tube connects the middle ear with the oropharynx.
questions.explanation: False – It connects with the nasopharynx.

questions.question: The perilymph fills the membranous labyrinth.
questions.explanation: False – The bony labyrinth contains perilymph; the membranous labyrinth contains endolymph.

questions.question: The semicircular canals are responsible for detecting angular acceleration.
The organ of Corti is located in the vestibule.
questions.explanation: False – It is located in the cochlear duct (scala media).
